verdict.rationale: pnpm's own docs name its lockfile as `pnpm-lock.yaml`, a YAML and therefore text-based file that an agent could read and diff (pnpm-docs-55, pnpm-docs-57). The docs also describe a single lockfile for a whole workspace and frozen-lockfile validation in CI (pnpm-docs-6, pnpm-docs-13, pnpm-docs-34). However, the evidence never documents the lockfile's schema or structure, so the 'documented format' part of the story is only implied. missing for 10: published lockfile format/schema documentation, any lockfile diff or readability guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent readability.
